Proposed fix: pick one symbol for the unknot (T_{1,0} or K_{0_1}) and carry the sigma consistently - beta-minus emits the barred one, beta-plus the unbarred.

trap-superlative.notes: STANDING-TRAP FINDINGS, report only, never fix math inline. (1) SECTION 7a GENERATOR VIOLATION, two sites: the Hecke relation is written 'T^2 = (q - q^{-1})T + 1' under 'The T_{3,5} weak vertex' and again in 'Re-reduction cost' item 2. AGENTS.md 7a is explicit that the generator is sigma_i and never T. Proposed fix: sigma_i^2 = (q - q^{-1}) sigma_i + 1 at both sites. (2) SECTION 7a SKEIN FORM: the block writes q[L_+] - q^{-1}[L_-] = (q^{1/2} - q^{-1/2})[L_0], whereas 7a's canonical relation is L_+ - L_- = (q - q^{-1}) L_0. The block's form is self-consistent with its own single-crossing amplitude s = q^{1/2} - q^{-1/2}, so this is a convention deviation to reconcile, not an arithmetic error. (3) UNPROVENANCED EXPERIMENTAL TARGETS: 'Predictions for heavy-nucleus half-lives overshoot by 10-17%' and 'The error for A = 3 is < 2%' carry no citation, no witness field and no producer. Two numbers doing load-bearing work in the argument for the 10-crossing correction. (4) CHECKED AND CORRECT: (sigma_1 sigma_2)^5 has 10 crossings; the budget 3 + 0 + 7 = 10; binom(A-1,1)*3 = 3(A-1); and the weak asymmetry S_ab - S_ba = (q - q^{-1})(mu_a - mu_b)/(q^{1/2} + q^{-1/2}) recomputed symbolically from the given S_ab, together with S_ab(q^{-1}) = S_ba(q).
